title: Policy Conditions: Cancellation for Nonpayment, Returned Payments and Reinstatement (Manufactured Home Insurance)
content:
A Manufactured Home Insurance installment left unpaid sets the following conditions in motion.

## Conditions

**A. Notice of cancellation for nonpayment.** When an installment remains unpaid for the nonpayment grace period after its due date, the notice of cancellation for nonpayment is mailed, stating a cancellation date that falls the nonpayment notice period after mailing and demanding the past-due premium. From the mailing the policy stands pending cancellation.

**B. Payment before the cancellation date.** Paying the whole past-due amount before the cancellation date keeps the policy in force. Otherwise coverage ends on the cancellation date, the policy is cancelled, and a lienholder named as loss payee is notified; where that loss payee is Hearthstone Home Finance, the insurance status recorded on the Hearthstone home loan becomes lapsed.

**C. Reinstatement window.** A policy cancelled for nonpayment may be reinstated only within the reinstatement window counted from the cancellation date. The reinstatement window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the cancellation date, and payment received on the last day reinstates the policy. The cancellation date is read from the policy record.

**D. Terms of reinstatement.** Reinstatement requires all past-due premium and leaves a gap: losses between the cancellation date and the reinstatement date are not covered. A reinstated policy is in force again; where its loss payee is Hearthstone Home Finance, the insurance status recorded on the Hearthstone home loan becomes in force.

**E. Returned payments.** A returned premium payment is charged back for the returned amount against that payment and treated as unpaid from its due date.

## Condition B in a table

| Payment received before the cancellation date | Result on the cancellation date |
|---|---|
| The whole past-due amount | The policy stays in force |
| Part of the past-due amount, or nothing | Coverage ends; the policy is cancelled |

## Timeline (hypothetical dates; 10-day notice period, 15-day reinstatement window)

- A notice of cancellation for nonpayment mailed on 12 May states a cancellation date 10 days later, 22 May.
- The whole past-due amount received on 21 May keeps the policy in force.
- With no full payment before 22 May, coverage ends on 22 May.
- The reinstatement window then runs from 23 May (day 1) to 6 June (day 15).

| Date all past-due premium is received | Within the window? | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 30 May | Yes (day 8) | Reinstated; losses from 22 May to 30 May are not covered |
| 6 June | Yes (day 15, the last day) | Reinstated; losses from 22 May to 6 June are not covered |
| 7 June | No | Not reinstated |

## Returned payment (hypothetical)

A $120.00 payment applied to an installment due 1 March is returned by the bank. The $120.00 is charged back against that payment, and the installment it paid is treated as unpaid from 1 March.
